The observations would conflict only if port identity were the number alone, since 8080 would then have two owners. I would record the identity definition as an accepted claim about the existing `port` entity, cite your exact wording as a verbatim source, and store the two observations as a trace with no potential-conflict edge. The one-owner rule was stated with 'should', which I have preserved; it is proposed rather than accepted because you asked only to record the identity definition.
